Before submitting your remix, check that you've followed all the rules, and make any adjustments if necessary:
Only @Kyle3912Again, @Twin138956Scratch, @ProDelta110, @Burgnew_On_A_Laptop, @ZYellow, @SmashBrosFan2020, @ScratchTeen9300, @legofan208, @Superflex29, @OisinFan62, @SuperScratchMaker001, @KARises, @Caden00, @-PenTPOT-, @ringtop02, @BobbyTheCatTheFirst, @TheDiamondDoggy, @Aydenfox8, @s-dbayer, @pika04034, @chomperthegamer, and @CZ2746isbackscratch (as well as their other accounts) are allowed to break these rules.
Rules marked with a ⚠️ can only be broken by @Kyle3912Again, @Twin138956Scratch, @ProDelta110, @Burgnew_On_A_Laptop, @ZYellow, @SmashBrosFan2020, @ScratchTeen9300, @KARises, and @ringtop02.

1. It is polite and REMIX ETIQUETTE to comment "Remixing..." in the comments before starting a remix, so people know not to accidentally split the remix tree's branches. If you don't intend to make a new remix branch, then don't remix if someone has commented "Remixing..."!
⚠️ 2. DO NOT BREAK SCRATCH'S COMMUNITY GUIDELINES (SCG), so nothing too scary, gory or vulgar!!
⚠️ 3. Don't add or remove anyone from the breaking rules list without permission. Furthermore, don't delete any of these rules or instructions & don't completely change the project title either.
⚠️ 4. Please make sure you credit @-Rex- for being the creator of a sprite used in this project! If you don't want to type the credits, copy this template below and paste it into the Notes and Credits:
Credit to @-Rex- for SFE++ ( https://scratch.mit.edu/projects/589579521/ )
5. Don't delete or ruin anything you didn't make, unless it breaks any rules or the SCG, to fix glitches, errors or rule-breaks, delete unused scripts, or (only if you know what you're doing or you're a rule-breaker) to add a new feature to the project.
6. You can add as many doors as you would like in a remix, but we recommend adding no more than 10 doors per remix.
7. If you add a door, make sure you put in a _doorCheck message script so the door counter will update.
8. Do not make your doors so big that they take up too much space of a room, unless it's part of its animation when clicked and reverts back to normal size when finished.
9. Please don't add any doors that are exact duplicates of doors from other parts of TSDoN... (This rule CAN be broken, but we really don't recommend doing this.)
10. Don't delete any music tracks unless they break the SCG or any rules. If you don't want to listen to a certain song or genre, utilize the "audio exemption" functionality to ensure you can't.
11. On the topic of music, please also refer to the Music comment's recommended music limit so this project's file size doesn't bloat too quickly.
12. If you are part of the "breaking rules" list, you're allowed to add a new rule if needed. Remember to add it to both the RULE RECAP comment and the project's instructions!
If you break any of these rules, it may result in your remix being declared UNOFFICIAL and becoming abandoned. You don't want that, right? To make sure this doesn't happen, remember to double-check the rules just before you share the project!

    1. It's suggested to comment "Remixing..." before starting your remix to try and prevent splitting the remix tree's paths. It's best not to remix if someone else already commented "Remixing"
        a. If the comments are turned off for a remix, then this rule is not necessary to follow as it wouldn't be possible to make the comment in that case. Also, if the "Remixing" comment is over a week old, then the remix will be considered cancelled and it will be safe to remix again, as it's unlikely that their remix will be finished on time.
        b. If you're planning on adding multiple doors, feel free to also reveal the numbers of the doors you'd like to add. This is optional.
    2. ️⚠️DON'T BREAK SCRATCH'S COMMUNITY GUIDELINES (SCG), so don't add anything too scary, gory, vulgar, or inappropriate in general. Extremely loud noises/screams also count since they could also be classified as too scary. This is the only rule that EVERYBODY (including rule-breakers, regardless of status) must follow when remixing.
    3. Don't modify the rule-breaker list without permission unless you have a valid reason (like switching accounts) to do so. Also, don't modify any rules and don't completely change the project's title.
    4. This project uses a sprite created by -Rex-, so be sure to put a credit for their sprite to the Notes and Credits. Another credit has also been included in the Instructions just in case. A good example of giving credit is below, which you can copy and paste into the Notes and Credits.
	
        Credit to @-Rex- for SFE++ ( https://scratch.mit.edu/projects/589579521 )
		
    5. Don't remove or mess up anything you didn't make, unless either A. it breaks any of these rules or the SCG, B. you're fixing any sort of error (including glitches), C. you're deleting unnecessary/unused scripts or variables, D. you're optimizing the scripts to help them run more smoothly, E. the thing specifically states, like in a comment in its sprite, that it can be modified (they might have different rules), or F. (if you know what you're doing) to add new functionality or feature to the project.
    6.You can add as many doors as you'd like in a single remix, though it's recommended not to go over 10 doors added at once. This doesn't mean you can't do so, it's just not recommended since other users may also want to add their own doors.
    7. If you add a door, be sure to use the "___door" broadcast script to allow the total door taps number to update each time someone clicks on the door. People might think things are inconsistent if some doors updated the number while others didn't...
    8. Do not make the default size of a door so large that it takes up a substantial portion of the room it's in, unless it's part of its animation and it eventually reverts back to its original size.
    9. Please do not add any doors that are exact duplicates of doors from other parts of TSDoN with only the door number being changed at most. This doesn't mean you can't do so, but it's highly recommended you AVOID doing this since each part could have a unique set of doors, and adding duplicate doors would add a little bit of redundancy. If a duplicate door is spotted, then anyone (rule-breaker or not) can choose to modify or replace the door with an original door if they so desire.
    10. Don't delete any of the music unless they break any rules or the SCG. If you don't want to listen to a specific song, be sure to utilize the audio exemption lists to ensure they won't catch into your ears. Furthermore, it's recommended to keep the overall number of songs within the recommended limits mentioned in the "Music" sprite so as to prevent the project's file size from getting too large too quickly.
    11. If you spot any gray question mark boxes in the project, please make sure to refresh the project page before remixing so the boxes don't persist into current remixes.
    12. Anyone who's part of the rule-breaker list is allowed to suggest new rules if necessary. Since the rules list is located here, I will have to update the list accordingly if the rule is good enough.


If you break any of these rules, your remix will be declared UNOFFICIAL and most likely end up being ignored in the mainline remix branch. To prevent this from happening, be sure to double-check these rules before sharing and follow them carefully to avoid any mistakes!

Hey there! If you want to add your own music, first separate your song into it's intro (if it has an intro) and it's looping part in separate sounds, tag "-Start" at the end of the intro's name, then tag "-Loop" at the end of the looping part's name. (Jingles won't have these tags, as they aren't intended to loop.) Add the song's name into the "Add music" block & finally drop it here! Remember that EVERYTHING must be correct spelling or else it won't work! If you're unsure, testing is recommended.

If the music track or jingle comes from a party game, like Mario Party, Sonic Shuffle, Wii Party or WarioWare: MEGA Party Game$, make sure it won't play for users who don't want those music tracks, like SmashBrosFan2020, via the audio-exemption lists & boolean. Same goes for other types of music like "gets faster" tracks, lyrical music, Flash/HTML5 game music, Miitopia music & non-looping music. 

Burgnew_On_A_Laptop recommends you please don't add any more than around 80 music tracks and jingles total, to prevent lag or the dreaded "refusal-to-save glitch" when modifiying the project on less powerful devices. It's also best to refrain from adding too many music tracks longer than 3 minutes (180 seconds) or too many "gets faster" tracks.

Credit to @WindowsMeRules2000 for this music system.

Only MisterChuChu, ZYellow, Burgnew_On_A_Laptop, TheStarSpirit, KARises, SMI_Productions, legofan208, Superflex29, OisinDaAnimeFan, Caden00, SmashBrosFan2020, Twin138956Scratch, ScratchTeen9300, and ringtop02 (as well as their other accounts) are allowed to break these rules.


    1. It's suggested to comment "Remixing..." before starting your remix to try and prevent splitting the remix tree's paths. It's best not to remix if someone else already commented "Remixing"
        a. If the comments are turned off for a remix, then this rule is not necessary to follow as it wouldn't be possible to make the comment in that case. Also, if the "Remixing" comment is over a week old, then the remix will be considered cancelled and it will be safe to remix again, as it's unlikely that their remix will be finished on time.
        b. If you're planning on adding multiple doors, feel free to also reveal the numbers of the doors you'd like to add. This is optional.
    2. ️⚠️DON'T BREAK SCRATCH'S COMMUNITY GUIDELINES (SCG), so don't add anything too scary, gory, vulgar, or inappropriate in general. Extremely loud noises/screams also count since they could also be classified as too scary. This is the only rule that EVERYBODY (including rule-breakers, regardless of status) must follow when remixing.
    3. Don't modify the rule-breaker list without permission unless you have a valid reason (like switching accounts) to do so. Also, don't modify any rules and don't completely change the project's title.
    4. This project uses a sprite created by -Rex-, so be sure to put a credit for their sprite to the Notes and Credits. Another credit has also been included in the Instructions just in case. A good example of giving credit is below, which you can copy and paste into the Notes and Credits.
	
        Credit to @-Rex- for SFE++ ( https://scratch.mit.edu/projects/589579521 )
		
    5. Don't remove or mess up anything you didn't make, unless either A. it breaks any of these rules or the SCG, B. you're fixing any sort of error (including glitches), C. you're deleting unnecessary/unused scripts or variables, D. you're optimizing the scripts to help them run more smoothly, E. the thing specifically states, like in a comment in its sprite, that it can be modified (they might have different rules), or F. (if you know what you're doing) to add new functionality or feature to the project.
    6.You can add as many doors as you'd like in a single remix, though it's recommended not to go over 10 doors added at once. This doesn't mean you can't do so, it's just not recommended since other users may also want to add their own doors.
    7. If you add a door, be sure to use the "___door" broadcast script to allow the total door taps number to update each time someone clicks on the door. People might think things are inconsistent if some doors updated the number while others didn't...
    8. Do not make the default size of a door so large that it takes up a substantial portion of the room it's in, unless it's part of its animation and it eventually reverts back to its original size.
    9. Please do not add any doors that are exact duplicates of doors from other parts of TSDoN with only the door number being changed at most. This doesn't mean you can't do so, but it's highly recommended you AVOID doing this since each part could have a unique set of doors, and adding duplicate doors would add a little bit of redundancy. If a duplicate door is spotted, then anyone (rule-breaker or not) can choose to modify or replace the door with an original door if they so desire.
    10. Don't delete any of the music unless they break any rules or the SCG. If you don't want to listen to a specific song, be sure to utilize the audio exemption lists to ensure they won't catch into your ears. Furthermore, it's recommended to keep the overall number of songs within the recommended limits mentioned in the "Music" sprite so as to prevent the project's file size from getting too large too quickly.
    11. If you spot any gray question mark boxes in the project, please make sure to refresh the project page before remixing so the boxes don't persist into current remixes.
    12. Anyone who's part of the rule-breaker list is allowed to suggest new rules if necessary. Since the rules list is located here, I will have to update the list accordingly if the rule is good enough.


If you break any of these rules, your remix will be declared UNOFFICIAL and most likely end up being ignored in the mainline remix branch. To prevent this from happening, be sure to double-check these rules before sharing and follow them carefully to avoid any mistakes!
